curator_note: Location-TBA, 11pm-6am is the right shape for a proper late one, but I can't vouch for the lineup. It's a punt on the WORK crew and the format.
description: WORK late-night electronic party at a to-be-announced LA venue, 11pm to 6am, with Akua, Ø [Phase] and Selective Response.

artist_notes.name: Guy J
artist_notes.note: Israeli progressive/melodic house producer and long-running Lost & Found label head; deep, slow-building sets in the Bedrock tradition.

artist_notes.name: Sahar Z
artist_notes.note: Israeli progressive/melodic house DJ in the same circle as Guy J; sets run long and hypnotic.

curator_note: Guy J is the draw. If you like sets that take an hour to build and then don't let go, this is it, and a 9pm-4am slot gives him room to stretch. Sahar Z is a natural pairing.
description: Two Israeli progressive and melodic house DJs, Guy J and Sahar Z, at ORIGIN, 9pm to 4am.

curator_note: A local-leaning tech-house and jackin' night at District 7 that runs until 5am. Fine if you want a late dance without a big-ticket headliner.
description: Putivuelta late-night tech-house party at District 7, 10pm to 5am, with Karsten Sollors, C:3, dustn, TOAD and Shane Thomas.

curator_note: Reliable first-and-third-Saturday disco and funk party at Gold Diggers, and the door has historically been cheap or free. It's an easy add-on to a bigger night more than a destination.
description: Recurring disco and groove dance party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, first and third Saturdays, from 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Zhu
artist_notes.note: Moody, synthy house producer behind "Faded"; plays darker, nocturnal sets that sit between house and downtempo.

curator_note: Zhu in a club-sized room is more interesting than his festival slots, and this is the second date, so the first sold out. It's a headliner-only bill at $74+, so go for the one set.
description: Zhu's second night at Reframe Studios Indoors, 10pm to 3am.

curator_note: An early 7-11pm holiday party at a WeHo hotel. It's a social night more than a serious dance one, and I couldn't verify the DJs. Skip unless you're already nearby.
description: Early-evening holiday dance party at Hotel Ziggy in West Hollywood, 7 to 11pm, with Allie M, Chad Aroo, Francesca Cloud and L3XI.
